plan.task: Implement H1 behind the unchanged C ABI. At stack creation, allocate bounded fixed-size storage for capacity slots and initialize a tagged free-slot head. Maintain a separate tagged published-top head for LIFO visibility, with per-slot length and next-index metadata. Push must claim a free slot before copying, so reserved capacity is visible to FULL; copy the borrowed bytes, then publish the slot with release ordering. Pop must acquire and claim only the published top, validate output capacity before mutation, copy the value out, and recycle the slot only after copying completes. Use a portable tagged index representation sized for the allowed capacity to avoid ABA on both heads, and preserve all existing invalid-input, status, handle-lifecycle, and teardown behavior. Verification strategy: first confirm the shared library builds and exports the existing ABI; then run the cheapest changed-path correctness checks covering the concurrent MPMC cases above and ownership/conservation; finally collect one short comparable A/B throughput point against the retained parent.
